999008199.text: 星の下に、祓え給い、星の子の行く先を、照らし給え

localizations.en: Beneath the stars, we cleanse thee. May the stars illuminate the path of their children.

999008199.text:
ありがとうございます。
今度こそ、心も穏やかになりました

localizations.en: Thank you so much. This time, I truly feel at peace.

999008199.text:
うむ。レスナに憑いた蛇神の意思も、
すっかり祓われたようだな

localizations.en: Indeed. It appears the serpent god's will that clung to Resna has been completely purified.

999008199.text: 千歳のお祓いは、すべてが美しい。存分にほめろ！

localizations.en: Chitose's purification is a thing of beauty in all aspects. Praise her to your heart's content!

999008199.text: か、鏑矢様……
千歳、ありがと！　アタシもなんだかスッキリした！

localizations.en: Thanks, Chitose! I feel refreshed too!

999008199.text: 私も……
今年も流れ星の導きが皆を照らしますように……

localizations.en: May the guidance of the shooting stars illuminate everyone this year as well...

999008199.text: アルビーナ、一番乗りおめでとう！

localizations.en: Alvina, congrats on taking first place!

999008199.text:
い、いや。あれは最後、馬神様が助けてくれたからで。
それに、トリモチとかも使ってたからさ

localizations.en: N-no, I mean... In the end, the Horse God helped me out. Plus, I used sticky mochi and stuff...

999008199.text:
アタシの勝ち方は、ダメじゃないかもしれないけど、
ずるかったんじゃ……

localizations.en: My way of winning might not have been terrible, but... wasn't it kind of underhanded...?

999008199.text:
ははは！　そのずるさで結果を出したんだ！
聞いた時も笑ったが、勝ったのは一興だったぞ！

localizations.en: Ha ha ha! That cunning of yours yielded results! I laughed when I heard about it, but your victory was quite entertaining!

999008199.text: はは。ですよね……

そんなことないよ。
アルビーナらしい勝ち方だなって思ったよ

localizations.en: That's not true at all. I thought it was such an Alvina way to win.

999008199.text:
私にはない考え方だし、そんな発想ができる
アルビーナのことを、すごいなって思ったんだから

localizations.en: It's a way of thinking I don't have, and I thought you were amazing for coming up with an idea like that.

999008199.text: ほ、ホントに？
うん。これからも頼りにしてる！

localizations.en: Yeah. I'm counting on you going forward too!

999008199.text: うん……へへ！　アルビちゃんにお任せあれ！

localizations.en: Yeah... Hehe! Leave it to Alvie!

999008199.text: 私も姉様と一緒に頑張る！

localizations.en: I'll do my best alongside you too!

999008199.text: アタシも頼りにしてるよ、ベップ！

localizations.en: I'm counting on you too, Bepp!

999008199.text: さて、ケイウンの年末年始は楽しかったか？

localizations.en: Now then, did you enjoy Keiun's New Year festivities?

999008199.text: はい！
馳走を用意した。共に新年を無事に祝おうではないか

localizations.en: I have prepared a feast. Let us celebrate the New Year together in good health.

999008199.text: わーお！　おせちの他にも、まだまだごちそうが！？

localizations.en: Whoa! There's even more food besides the osechi?!

999008199.text:
先ほど、どういうわけか大量の貢ぎ物が届いたのだ。
ありがたくいただくとしよう

localizations.en: For some reason, a great quantity of tribute was delivered just moments ago. We shall gratefully partake of it.

999008199.text:
そういえば、祓われる時に蛇神様が
詫びの品を用意するって言っていたような……

localizations.en: Now that you mention it, I think the serpent god said something about preparing an apology gift during the purification...

999008199.text:
思わぬごちそう！　こりゃ、早速今年一番の加護が
働いたのかもだね！

localizations.en: An unexpected feast! Maybe this is the first blessing of the year already at work!

999008199.text: ははは。そうかもしれんな。行くぞ

localizations.en: Ha ha ha. Perhaps so. Come now.

999008199.text: はい！
